beats.text: You think everyone noticed your embarrassing shirt. They didn't.
In a study, students had to wear a very embarrassing T-shirt into a room full of people.
Each dot is one person in that room. The bright one is you.
The wearers guessed: about half of the room noticed.
The real number: only about one in four!
Everyone else is busy thinking about themselves. Just like you. So next time

sources: Gilovich, Medvec & Savitsky (2000), The spotlight effect in social judgment, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 78(2), 211–222 – students wearing an embarrassing (Barry Manilow) T-shirt estimated that about 46 % of the others in the room noticed it; about 23 % actually did.
